items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-kawara-farmhouse
reasons: View: the hipped kawara roof is a foreshortened top plane, rows 11-34. Under it the front (plaster, beam, shoji, engawa, plinth) runs rows 35-79. No side planes and no isometry. The hip triangles at x 3-15 and x 78-92 carry vertical 4px stripes, lighter on the west and darker on the east.
Rule 1: roof share is 34.8%, inside the 30-36% band.
Rule 3 eave holds: course dark row 30 (373d52), bright tip 31 (8588ad), dark 32 (465166) and 33 (282a3d), outline 34 (#1a1226), wall shadow row 35 (7d8592/948fa3), then the plaster.

Rule 4 holds: the ridge box runs rows 12-18. Joints sit only in course 1 (rows 19-22) and course 2 (rows 23-26), every 4px (57697d at x 14, 18, 22...). Course 3 (rows 27-30) has only 3px marks (x 23-25, x 67-69).

Rule 5 is now met, which clears the old charge. The ridge box has a light row 12, cream noshi row 14, tan row 16 and dark rows 17-18. Both ends have an end block: left x 16-23 rows 12-17, right x 72-78 rows 12-16. Each is light top-left and dark bottom-right, with a 1px 373d52/282a3d divider on its inner side. In map 01 at 1x both ends read as small light knobs.

Blemish below charge level: the ridge box rows leak through the end blocks. The noshi cream pixel at (17,14) and (77,14) and the tan pixels at (16-17,16) and (77,16) sit inside or outside the blocks. This makes the blocks mottled rather than solid 5x6 shapes like the kura's (x 3-8, rows 10-15).
fixes: Optional polish: stop the noshi row 14 and the tan row 16 at the end-block dividers (x 23 and x 72). Fill each end block as a clean shape, a0a2c7 in the top-left 2x2, 6d7494 body, 373d52 bottom row. Remove the stray cream/tan pixels at x 16-17 and x 77.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-wooden-station
reasons: Old rule 5 charge is cleared. There is now a ridge box: row 20 b88165 light, row 22 e0dbb7 noshi, rows 23-25 darker, joint row 26. Both ends have d1a181 end blocks with a dark 521e21/3d151f inner divider (left x 18-26, right x 85-92). Rule 1 passes at 34.7%. The eave holds: tip 854a38 row 41, 3d151f rows 42-43, outline row 44, shadow row 45.

Charge 3 and roof rule 6: the front gable was not removed or rebuilt, only shrunk and smeared. A small clock gable remains at x 40-66, rows 24-39. Its face is a flat grey-brown board (705c4a/593e39 at x 54-62, rows 26-37) with a white clock (x 53-58, rows 28-33). It has no roof of its own. Its only 'roof' is a 1px bright b88165/9e644d rake drawn diagonally over the front courses, from (41,38) up to (53,25). There is no right rake at all: the tile courses run straight through the right half of the triangle. A bright b88165 base line runs over tile row 39 (x 40-72). The rule forbids bright lines drawn over the front courses.

Read at 1x: the gable reads as a lopsided brown smudge with a clock stuck on the tile slope, not as a gable or dormer. Maps/03 still shows the previous version (a full front gable), so the map does not reflect this redraw.

Roof rule 2 and 8 (lesser): the white tin canopy (ribs eff2f6/dce1e8/dce1e8/c3c9d3, rows 48-52) ends in 999dad (row 53) and 666775 (row 54) with no #1a1226 outline row under its eave. It bleeds into the wall at row 55. The jp-station_small anchor closes its canopy with a full ink row (row 64).
Course 4 (rows 39-40) is only 2 rows before the eave tip, and the gable's light base line sits on it. The lowest course is truncated.
fixes: Choose one: (a) Delete the gable entirely. Restore rows 24-39 at x 40-72 to the normal courses (course 1-2 with 521e21 joints every 4px, courses 3-4 with no joints and sparse 3px marks). Remove the b88165 rake and the row-39 base line, and move the clock to the wall or canopy fascia as a small part sprite. (b) Rebuild it as a proper hafu/dormer. It needs its own small tile roof with both rakes, each drawn as a 2-3 row sloped tile band with an ink outline, plus a bright tip and dark eave under each rake. The board face sits below them with a shadow row. Keep it symmetric, with no 1px bright line laid over the main roof courses.
Close the canopy: after the white ribs, add one pale tip row (e6e2f0/cac7d6), then a #1a1226 outline row at row 54, then a wall shadow row at row 55.
Give the lowest tile course a full 4 rows (light, body, body, dark) before the eave tip, or merge it so that no truncated course sits above the tip.

summary: Group A: 1 pass, 1 fail. kawara-farmhouse passes. Its onigawara ends now exist at both ridge ends, the roof share is 34.8%, the eave and course grammar are correct and the 3/4 view is clean. One cosmetic note: noshi/tan pixels leak through the end blocks. wooden-station fails. Its ridge box and end blocks are fixed and the roof share is 34.7%. But the front clock gable remains as a lopsided flat board with only a 1px bright left rake drawn over the tile courses, no right rake and no roof of its own (charge 3, roof rule 6). The tin canopy also has no ink outline under its eave. maps/03 still shows the old station render.
